<includeonly>[[Category:Navigation templates]]</includeonly><noinclude>[[Category:Template Documentation]]</noinclude>
Used for [[release information]] pages.

A formatted list of versions (sorted by ascending release date) should go at NAMESPACE:Release information/List (see [[CV:Release information/List]] for an example).

By default, this template displays versions for the namespace where it is used, but this can be changed by passing a <code>ns=</code> parameter, e.g. <nowiki>{{release notes|ns=40d}}</nowiki>:

{{release notes|ns=40d}}
